Thus did the wretched consorts of Ravana speak amidst their

" Not heeding the advice of thy friend, who ever offered thee

brief.summary_1line: Ravana’s wives rush to the battlefield, mourn his fallen body, and lament that his abduction of Sita and rejection of counsel brought their destruction.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana’s disheveled consorts run onto the gore-stained battlefield, wailing among headless bodies as they search for their fallen king.
The women collapse over Ravana’s massive corpse in the dust, some clutching his feet and neck while others faint and weep.
One widow cradles Ravana’s head in her lap, her tears falling across his face like frost settling on a lotus.
